whoosh.about: a move across the frame, a transition
whoosh.prompt: a single short airy whoosh of a fast swipe past the listener, mid-range, no hiss, quick tail, isolated, studio quality

swish.about: a quick small move: a line drawn, a bar that fills, a card that swaps
swish.prompt: a single quick bright swish of a thin cane cutting through the air, crisp, isolated, studio quality

riser.about: a build-up whose climax lands on the cue
riser.prompt: a rising tension riser, filtered noise and a tone climbing fast, ends abruptly, isolated, studio quality

drop.about: something that falls or goes down
drop.prompt: a short descending pitch drop of a small object falling, soft landing, isolated, studio quality

impact.about: the big hit of a reveal or a turn
impact.prompt: a deep cinematic impact boom, punchy sub hit, short dry tail, isolated, studio quality

hit.about: a small dry hit: a cut, a snap, a word that lands
hit.prompt: a single short dry punchy percussive hit, tight snap, no reverb, isolated, studio quality

thud.about: something set down, docked, stacked or closed
thud.prompt: a single soft muffled thud of a small box set down on a wooden table, close-miked, isolated, studio quality

stamp.about: a stamp, a seal, a validation pressed on
stamp.prompt: a rubber stamp pressed firmly on paper, a single hit, close-miked, isolated, studio quality

pop.about: an element that appears: a bubble, a tag, a chip
pop.prompt: a soft round bubble pop, short and warm, isolated, studio quality

click.about: an interface click: a button, a key, a switch, a selection
click.prompt: a single crisp computer mouse click, close-miked, isolated, studio quality, no background noise

type.about: one keystroke of typed text (a cue per key or per word)
type.prompt: a single mechanical keyboard keystroke, close and dry, isolated, studio quality

tick.about: a counter, a clock, rolling digits (a cue's i of n climbs an octave)
tick.prompt: a single short crisp high wooden clock tick, close-miked, isolated, studio quality

blip.about: a short electronic beep: a signal, a pulse, a sonar
blip.prompt: a short soft electronic blip, a digital interface beep, isolated, studio quality

chime.about: a success, a notification, a bright resolve
chime.prompt: a bright sparkling success chime, glassy and short, isolated, studio quality

error.about: a failure, a loss, an alarm
error.prompt: a short negative error buzz, two low descending tones, isolated, studio quality

shimmer.about: a shine, a sparkle, a scan of light
shimmer.prompt: a magical shimmer sparkle, high glittering and airy, isolated, studio quality

glitch.about: a digital glitch: scrambled text, a rewind, a scratch
glitch.prompt: a short digital glitch, stuttering data noise, isolated, studio quality

paper.about: paper: a flap, a tear, a page flipped, a print
paper.prompt: a quick paper flip, a single page turned, crisp, close-miked, isolated, studio quality
